description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Panthers OL Damien Lewis was at practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Lewis is working his way back from an ankle injury. His status will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.
items.title: Damien Lewis (elbow) at practice Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Veteran LB Germaine Pratt has re-signed with Colts.
items.impact: Pratt will join the Colts practice squad.
items.title: Germaine Pratt re-signs with Colts

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Chargers coach Jim Harbaugh said that Ladd McConkey is "working back in this week."
items.impact: McConkey was active this past week, but he did not see the field. His status will need to be monitored the rest of this week.
items.title: Ladd McConkey (foot) 'working back this week'

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Chargers coach Jim Harbaugh said Quentin Johnston will "probably be limited this week like last for the practice."
items.impact: "We'll see where he's at the end of the week," Harbaugh said. Johnston will have a chance to return in Week 6.
items.title: Quentin Johnston (chest) expected to be limited in practice

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Chargers coach Jim Harbaugh said Tre' Harris is "more of a week-to-week [thing]."
items.impact: Harris will likely be targeting a return in Week 8 following the Chargers bye.
items.title: Tre' Harris (hamstring) considered week-to-week

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Chargers coach Jim Harbaugh said OT Joe Alt will see a specialist.
items.impact: Alt remains week-to-week.
items.title: Joe Alt (neck) to visit specialist

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: NFL Network's Ian Rapoport reports Jauan Jennings "would be a name for me to keep an eye on" for the 49ers.
items.impact: Jennings has been disappointing to start the season with the Vikings. A reunion with the 49ers could be a possibility as their wide receiver room remains banged up.
items.title: Jauan Jennings: 49ers team to monitor

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Cowboys are expected to re-sign RB Emari Demercado.
items.impact: Demercado had been competing with Tyler Goodson for the backup role. He will remain off the fantasy radar.
items.title: Emari Demercado expected to re-sign with Cowboys

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Panthers coach Dave Canales said Jalen Coker is "on track" to play in Carolina's Week 6 game against the Eagles.
items.impact: This confirms a previous report from Monday. He was spotted practicing on Tuesday.
items.title: Jalen Coker (quad) remains on track to return in Week 6

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Browns are reportedly seeking a third or fourth-round pick for WR Jerry Jeudy.
items.impact: Jordan Schultz reported he's not sure they'll be able to get it. Jeudy will be a player to monitor closer to the trade deadline.
items.title: Jerry Jeudy could be traded by Browns

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Rams signed kicker Blake Grupe off the Jets practice squad.
items.impact: Grupe will get an opportunity with the Rams with Harrison Mevis released.
items.title: Blake Grupe signed by Rams

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Rams released kicker Harrison Mevis.
items.impact: Mevis missed two field goals in Monday's loss against the Bills. The Rams signed Blake Grupe off the Jets practice squad as the corresponding move.
items.title: Harrison Mevis released by Rams

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Panthers placed DT Cam Jackson on injured reserve with a shoulder injury.
items.impact: Jackson will be sidelined for at least the next four weeks.
items.title: Cam Jackson (shoulder) placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Panthers have opened the practice window for Trevor Etienne.
items.impact: Etienne missed the start of the season due to an ankle injury he suffered in the preseason. He will have 21 days to officially be activated by Carolina.
items.title: Trevor Etienne (ankle) has practice window opened

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Panthers have opened the practice window for Tershawn Wharton.
items.impact: Wharton missed the start of the season due to a neck injury. He will have 21 days to officially be activated by Carolina.
items.title: Tershawn Wharton (neck) has practice window opened

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Panthers have opened the practice window for Taylor Moton.
items.impact: Moton missed the start of the season due to a blood clot. He will have 21 days to officially be activated by Carolina.
items.title: Taylor Moton (blood clot) has practice window opened

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Patriots LT Will Campbell avoided a major knee injury Sunday and is considered week-to-week.
items.impact: It is positive news for Campbell and the Patriots. He will likely miss at least one game, but he shouldn't miss too much time.
items.title: Will Campbell (knee) considered week-to-week

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Panthers released LB Cam Gill.
items.impact: Gill will figure to seek another opportunity.
items.title: Cam Gill released by Panthers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Panthers signed CB Robert Rochell.
items.impact: Rochell was with Carolina last year and earlier this season.
items.title: Robert Rochell signs with Panthers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Eagles defensive coordinator Vic Fangio said that it would be "miraculous" if Jalyx Hunt is able to play against the Panthers in Week 6.
items.impact: Hunt left last Sunday's game with knee and ankle injuries. He is likely to miss at least one game.
items.title: Jalyx Hunt (knee/ankle) unlikely to play in Week 6

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Kaevon Merriweather has been signed from the practice squad to the Jaguars' active roster.
items.impact: Merriweather saw in-game action for the first time this season in the Jaguars' Week 5 win over the Eagles. The veteran defensive back played in his familiar special-teams role and saw about a third of the snaps on defense with safety Eric Murray (concussion) sidelined.
items.title: Kaevon Merriweather joins Jaguars roster

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Devin Neal has signed with the Commanders.
items.impact: Neal will initially join Washington's practice squad to provide depth at running back. The second-year pro was released by the Vikings last week. After being selected in the sixth round of last year's NFL Draft, Neal played in 10 games for the Saints last season, rushing for over 200 yards and a couple of touchdowns on 57 carries. He also displayed pass-catching ability, securing 17 of 19 targets for 104 yards.
items.title: Devin Neal signs with Commanders

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: TreVeyon Henderson will miss multiple weeks due to a high-ankle sprain.
items.impact: Henderson left Sunday's game early and was reevaluated Monday. On a positive note, the young running back will not require surgery, but he is going to miss some games. Veteran Rhamondre Stevenson will take over as the ball carrier in Henderson's absence.
items.title: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) to miss multiple weeks

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Tanner Hudson (pectoral) will miss the rest of the season.
items.impact: After hauling in his first touchdown pass of the campaign in Week 5, Hudson is dealing with a torn pectoral that will force him out for the remainder of the season. Erick All Jr. saw an uptick in snaps after Hudson left Sunday's game.
items.title: Tanner Hudson (pectoral) to miss rest of the season

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: The Rams D/ST allowed 37 points while notching one sack and forcing two turnovers in a 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills in Week 5.
items.impact: Los Angeles had a tough time slowing the Bills offense, especially on the ground as Buffalo racked up 234 rushing yards. The Rams did recover a James Cook fumble in overtime. The Rams will look to bounce back against the Cardinals in Week 6.
items.title: Rams D/ST allows 37 points in OT loss
